summary: This June 26 Dante #11 source extends the Purgatory cluster by making reflection, prayer, free will, dangerous guidance, poetic summoning, morphic-field embodiment, and fire-as-firming all parts of one purgatorial mechanics of voluntary transformation.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Pure love is to gift free will and free choice, so the cosmos is designed for maximum agency rather than divine override.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public read already links this exact mark to the Free Will anchor. The source strengthens the existing free-will-as-love mechanism rather than requiring a new Free Will child.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Virgil is an outside entity who trains focus, but the universe also warns Dante to beware Virgil because the guide can become the siren and rival.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source directly extends the existing necessary-guide anchor with the later Purgatory form: the guide is needed as an outer body for attention, then becomes a dangerous internal identity.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Poets are prophets, fiction becomes summoning rather than invention, and art works as a portal into a larger field of memory and vision.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The Dante access child now owns poetic access, reception, and summoning. This source should feed that child only in replacement or compression, not reopen the Poetry parent.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Love can be infinite where wealth is finite, and the endorsed love formulation is to keep loving without needing possession or return.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Love Recognizes owns the relational mechanism when love is distinguished from possession, return, praise, or finite material goods.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use in a future Free Will replacement/compression: Dante #11 sharpens the source's prior Purgatory-as-opportunity pressure. God gives agency because pure love cannot control; broken worlds become repair duties rather than excuses to blame God; purgatorial fire firms the soul rather than merely hurting it.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Free Will owns agency, repair duty, chosen orientation, and purification as voluntary firming. Eschatology owns sacred sequence and role-script; Poetry owns the medium; Love Recognizes owns concrete relation.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use in the next Guide Trap compression: the source gives the Purgatory form of the necessary guide. Virgil focuses Dante as an outside entity, but the siren/dream sequence makes the guide a rival and internal danger: Dante is now Virgil and must not get stillborn in Virgil.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Guide Trap owns the guide as attention trainer, seducer, rival, and internalized identity. Dante Access owns the poem's reception machinery; Imperial Poetry owns Virgil's weaponized imperial poem.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold for a future Dante child replacement/compression: Jiang treats a student's dream as already inside Dante's symbolic field, then says poets are prophets, Virgil is summoned rather than invented, visions are downloaded, and art is a portal into universal memory.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: The Dante child owns this as access and reception. The Poetry parent should not receive another ordinary Dante append after PR #1180; use this only where it replaces or compresses existing access/summoning language.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use only as replacement material if Poetry parent is compressed again: this source supplies a late-June Dante formulation of poet-prophet-teacher, art as portal, divine spark as soul-field, and the writer as a vessel chosen to bring visions into the secular world.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Poetry owns the civilizational medium only at the parent level. Dante-specific reception belongs to the Dante child; Dead World owns anti-reductionist field ontology; Free Will owns agency.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold as background for a future Dead World or sacred-perception review: the lecture names souls as morphic fields, treats the body as a field-pattern that can persist after flesh, and says heaven bends those fields toward divine light rather than reducing personhood to biology.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Dead World owns the anti-reductionist field ontology. This should not become a standalone Morphic Fields page from one Dante source; compare first against the held cosmic-memory-as-access-field and sacred-perception proposals.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold for future Love Recognizes or Human Heart compression: the source distinguishes infinite love from finite wealth, then turns courtly love and Virgil's love theory into a test of whether love can praise without possession, domination, return, or narrative punishment.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Love Recognizes owns love as non-possessive recognition. Free Will owns the power to curb desire; Guide Trap owns Virgil's theory when it becomes dangerous guidance.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2026-06-26, this follows Dante #10 by moving from Purgatory as opportunity into Purgatory as a full moral physics of reflection, prayer, self-punishment, free will, embodied soul-fields, and fire that firms desire.

The source gives a late-June 2026 Dante formulation of free will as the meaning of divine love: God gifting agency, refusing fatalism, and requiring humans to repair the broken world rather than blame God for it.

Dante #11 is the strongest current Purgatory support for the guide becoming internal: Virgil first focuses Dante, then the siren dream warns that Dante is now Virgil and must beware being seduced by the guide's own poetic identity.
The lecture extends the newly split Dante access child by joining classroom dream, poet-prophet, summoning, downloaded visions, and delayed symbolic recognition into one access mechanism.

The morphic-field and body-shaped soul language adds a Dante-specific field-metaphysics layer to the existing anti-reductionist trail, but it should be compared against prior cosmic-memory and sacred-perception records before any public child is considered.

next_actions.note: After this compact intake, resume the already named public synthesis target: Eschatology split/hold judgment around Sacred Sequence Becomes Geopolitical Choreography. Do not take another one-source intake before that unless a maintainer explicitly changes the sequence.

The strongest downstream public extension candidates are Free Will compression around Purgatory as voluntary firming and Guide Trap compression around Virgil as necessary focus who becomes the siren/rival inside Dante.

Do not append this source mechanically to Poetry parent or the Dante child. Use only replacement/compression language for poet-prophet, summoning, dream-reception, and portal/field access, because PR #1180 already extracted the Dante access child.

Do not promote Morphic Fields, Purgatory As Opportunity, Prayer For The Dead, Fire Makes The Soul Firm, Poet As Prophet, Dante Dream, Statius, Forese/Nella, Rhipeus, Courtly Love, or Virgil As Siren as standalone pages from this source alone.

If provenance work follows later, link only exact marks for free-will-love-refuses-contract, guide-trap-necessary-guide, poetry-invades-and-remakes-reader, and heart-love-recognizes-person. Avoid bulk-linking every Dante, Purgatory, Virgil, prayer, dream, or fire mark.
